# Adeept PiCar-B V5.1 — Vendor Reference Code

This folder contains selected examples from the `ADR012-V5.1_PiCar-B_MarsRover_SmartCarKit_for_RPi-20260407` package identified in the existing project documentation. Examples cover motors, servos, LEDs, buzzer, ultrasonic sensing, line tracking and battery monitoring.

These files are kept as vendor reference material and are separate from the StormDrive V2 competition software in [`src/v2/`](../../src/v2/README.md). Their exact upstream source, license and file-by-file modification status have not yet been verified. See [ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md) and complete its TODOs before making licensing or unchanged-copy claims.

Tutorials, datasheets, web/voice-control material and generated bytecode were not included in this selected reference folder.
